description: This file defines an Android activity that sets up a tab interface with right-aligned tab widgets. It extends TabActivity and implements TabHost.TabContentFactory to create content views for each tab.

classes.name: Tabs6
classes.description: An activity class that creates a tab interface with custom right gravity for tab widgets, allowing users to switch between different tab content views.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and adds three tabs with specified indicators and content factory.

methods.name: createTabContent
methods.description: Creates and returns a simple TextView containing the tab's tag as content.
